critical_code_review_comments: Note: window.document.documentElement carries the 'lenis' class in Playwright mobile-viewport tests because isTouchDevice() checks 'ontouchstart' / navigator.maxTouchPoints which Playwright does not toggle just from viewport resize. On a real touch device the Lenis rAF is correctly skipped. The mobile heavy-motion gates that DO fire in the browser (matchMedia min-width:1024, hover:hover, pointer:fine) are correctly OFF — hero SVG filters count = 0, grain::after display = none — so the actual perf-critical gating is intact. If stricter test emulation is desired, use browser context with has_touch=True; not a product bug.
site.js is clean: COACH has no whatsapp/phone fields, PACKAGES has exactly 2 entries, MEALS[0].time = '09:00'.
Footer.jsx and Contact.jsx both retain email + Instagram only — no phone/WhatsApp references left in JSX.
